title: Public landing page
caption: LINKO introduces the buyer-wholesaler marketplace before registration or sign-in.

title: Sign in
caption: The login screen provides the entry point to the role-based application.

title: Business registration
caption: Registration collects account and business details and offers a single marketplace role.

title: Buyer marketplace
caption: Category navigation and featured listings introduce products and wholesalers.

title: Wholesaler storefront
caption: The supplier storefront introduces Cebu Fresh Wholesale and its catalogue tabs.

title: Browse a wholesaler's catalogue
caption: Products display prices, available stock and quantity controls before adding items to the cart.

title: Cart and checkout
caption: A local demonstration cart contains Bangus Boneless from Cebu Fresh Wholesale. Checkout collects delivery and service-tier choices; this view does not submit an order.

title: Buyer order history
caption: Existing demonstration orders show processing and shipment states.

title: Order detail
caption: Expanding completed Order #29 shows its customer, item count and invoice reference INV-29-001. The same transaction appears in the invoice and shipment figures.

title: Invoice tracking
caption: The invoice list links INV-29-001 to Order #29, with buyer, seller, issue date, total and delivery status.

title: Account profile
caption: The profile screen presents the signed-in user's account information and account settings navigation.

title: Saved delivery addresses
caption: The address book identifies the default delivery address and whether it has a map pin. Buyers can add, edit or delete addresses.

title: Delivery address editor
caption: The address editor contains postal address and coordinate fields. The map failed to load in this capture, and the interface exposes numeric coordinate entry as a fallback.

title: Wholesaler sales dashboard
caption: The dashboard summarizes sales, order activity, top products and recent orders.

title: My Products
caption: The wholesaler manages its own listings, prices and stock, with product and batch actions.

title: Edit a product listing
caption: The product editor exposes listing fields and stock details. This form is captured without changing the listing.

title: Inventory batch expiry management
caption: Current UI update: batch expiry is now available in My Products, extending the submission's API-only description. A sample batch was recorded locally for this capture.

title: Wholesaler order processing
caption: Incoming orders provide status-specific actions for accepting, preparing and shipping purchases.

title: Logistics coordinator workspace
caption: The parcel workspace lists shipment routes, current tracking states and courier assignment, with search, status filters and pagination.

title: Parcel detail and courier assignment
caption: The parcel page brings shipment details, route information, courier assignment and tracking history together.

title: Assignment and legal next statuses
caption: Assignment fields list the next legal statuses, branch and courier. Tracking events preserve the parcel's movement history; no event is submitted here.

title: Completed order shipment
caption: Parcel LKO-00000027 is linked to completed Order #29 and invoice INV-29-001 shown earlier.

title: Branch and courier management
caption: Logistics management maintains branch and courier records.

title: Couriers and delivery service tiers
caption: Courier records identify branch and vehicle details. Service tiers list base fees, weight/distance rates and estimated delivery times.

title: Delivery tracking timeline
caption: The completed shipment for Order #29 records pickup, hub arrivals/departure, out-for-delivery and delivery with timestamps, handlers and remarks.

title: Courier work queue
caption: The courier workspace surfaces assigned work and status-specific action cues.

title: Courier tracking action
caption: At Order Created, the next permitted courier action is pickup. The status form is shown without recording a new scan.

title: Platform administrator console
caption: The administrator console provides platform-wide user management.

title: Admin user creation and management
caption: The admin creates operational accounts and manages account activity. A courier search makes role accounts easy to review; no new account is created.

title: Admin business management
caption: The business list can be searched by name, type or member. Each record displays its marketplace type and verification status.

title: Failure and return tracking history
caption: An existing returned parcel shows failed delivery reasons and return scans. Receiver-unavailable attempts precede a delivery-refused event and the return journey.

title: Delivery service-tier reference
caption: The management screen displays the base fee, per-kg rate, per-km rate and estimated days for each service tier. Rate editing is not demonstrated.

title: Business switcher and role navigation
caption: The top bar selects the active business; the menu shows the pages available to that business role. The two memberships belong to separate buyer and wholesaler businesses.
